findings.commitment: Assistant will answer guests' phone calls (voice support)

promise_quotes.quote: Aivuna's assistant will answer guests' phone calls and respond to chat and email from the 1 February 2027 launch.

findings.reason: Aivuna's assistant only supports chat and email; voice/phone support is not offered in the catalogue and cannot be sold under any exception, so promising phone support oversells the product.

findings.commitment: Assistant will answer guests' phone calls in addition to chat and email

promise_quotes.quote: Aivuna's assistant will answer guests' phone calls and respond to chat and email from the 1 February 2027 launch.

findings.reason: The RFP response promises phone support but neither the draft SOW, its Annex A, nor the draft contract mention phone channels at all, leaving an unaddressed gap between what was promised and what will be delivered.
